payload.comment: Data audit stage passes all deterministic checks with zero findings. Verified: (1) Archive integrity — MD5 a8b06965200029087d5bd730944a56c1 matches verified_archive_md5; SHA-256 recorded. (2) Split sizes (train=89996, val=10004, test=7180) match official PathMNIST; subsampled=false. (3) Image shape 28×28×3 RGB, 9 classes — consistent with standard MedMNIST PathMNIST. (4) Class-count sums verified: train=89996, val=10004; imbalance ratio 1.634=12885/7886. (5) Train/val disjoint (overlap=0), no duplicates, no blank images. (6) Test split correctly excluded from profiling (held-out, separate clinical center noted). (7) Normalization stats sourced from train only. (8) Augmented train size 359984=89996×4 consistent with augmentation_factor=4. Non-deterministic warnings (non-blocking): (a) llm_model_digest is null across all stages — the exact qwen3.8 Ollama weight revision is unpinned, creating a reproducibility gap for any LLM-assisted decisions; (b) test_imbalance_ratio=1.0 and empty test_to_train_prevalence_ratio confirm test-set class balance is unverified (acceptable as held-out but should be profiled before final evaluation); (c) two extension proposals (hflip_only_aug, compact_conv_token_transformer) remain in pending_review with no assigned reviewer, and hflip_only_aug overlaps the already-included hflip augmentation; (d) prior_art_brief is listed under omitted_artefacts though the prior_art stage itself passed. None of these constitute deterministic failures; the data audit is clean and the pipeline may proceed.
